data.summary:
* Split `taskGroupSummaryFirestoreRepository.ts` from 971 → 295 lines into three files: `serializer.ts` (pure doc↔model conversion + aggregation helpers), `queries.ts` (SDK ref/query construction), and a thin orchestration adapter.
  * Preserved `TaskGroupSummaryRepository` interface, Firestore doc shape, composite-index usage, fire-and-forget vs Result semantics, `merge:true` on recompute, and `FieldValue.delete()` semantics.
  * Added 77 serializer unit tests + 12 queries unit tests; kept the 104 existing repo integration tests unchanged and passing.
  * Code review surfaced three issues (stale v8-ignore pragmas on now-pure branches, accidental `asDocRef` re-export, dead identity-cast wrappers) — all fixed in a follow-up commit with concrete replacement tests.
  * `pnpm run ci:tracked` passes end-to-end; PR #1930 opened against `development`.
